{

    {

      "stance": "objection",

    },
    {
      "login": "sedited",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "withdrew initial ACK after measuring an AssembleBlock regression, which was resolved by updating the benchmark; later suggested testing real block creation timings"
    },
    {
      "login": "Sjors",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK for speeding up checkBlock IPC for Stratum v2"
    },
    {
      "login": "optout21",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "supported performance improvement follow-up; suggested reusing ConnectBlockView at line 3055"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:5058239886",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "slowdown in AssembleBlock benchmark when using overlay view",
      "quote": "I see it in the report too, and can measure the slowdown locally as well.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author pushed a commit updating the benchmark to fill blocks to max weight, resolving the measured regression",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5118541917"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5118541917",
      "status_by_quote": "I've included an additional commit at the start that improves the AssembleBlock benchmark by filling the block to max weight with transactions."
    },
    {
      "id": "r:4912955569",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "reentrant calls to TestBlockValidity reusing ConnectBlockView while a synchronous callback is active during a fetch",
      "quote": "I think the reentrancy issue needs to be addressed before this can be merged.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author proposed an assert to guard against reentrancy; reviewer agreed in rc:3866882847 but the fix has not yet been pushed",

        "rc:3839674305"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3839674305",
      "status_by_quote": "We can prevent this by calling Assert(overlay_view.GetCacheSize() == 0); inside TestBlockValidity."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5051664610",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "usefulness",
      "text": "provide a reproducible way to test the performance claim using deterministic proposals or a microbenchmark",
      "quote": "Could you provide a reproducible way to test the performance claim, ideally using a deterministic set of mainnet block proposals or a microbenchmark?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author updated the AssembleBlock benchmark and provided before/after measurements",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5053739755",
        "c:5118541917"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5118541917",
      "status_by_quote": "I've included an additional commit at the start that improves the AssembleBlock benchmark by filling the block to max weight with transactions."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5058336826",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "introduce a heuristic to skip background fetching if the block does not spend many coins",
      "quote": "Maybe it would be worthwhile to introduce a heuristic where we skip background fetching if the block does not spend a lot of coins?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author declined, explaining blocks spending few coins are already fast",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5118541917"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5118541917",
      "status_by_quote": "what we really care about is that slow blocks are faster. A block spending few coins is already very fast, and so speeding it up from 2ms -> 1ms will not really benefit anything in the grand scheme IMO."
    },
    {
      "id": "r:4880773604",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "use the newly introduced ConnectBlockView() helper for m_connect_block_view at line 3055",
      "quote": "Could this also use the newly introduced ConnectBlockView()?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author updated the callsite to use ConnectBlockView()",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5227266815"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5227266815",
      "status_by_quote": "Done."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3790983748",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "assert the max weight claim in the benchmark and adjust FAN_OUT to make it true",
      "quote": "can we assert the claim (and adjust the FAN_OUT to make it true? Just make sure the number is not 110, we're still sensitive to that...)",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5957437978",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "usefulness",
      "text": "measure real block creation timings side-by-side with master on a similar mempool",
      "quote": "I think it would be interesting to add some more real block creation timings, i.e. run this side-by-side with master on hopefully a similar mempool and see if there is a difference.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author agreed to gather real-world data and marked the PR as draft",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5958877977"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5958877977",
      "status_by_quote": "Yes, good idea. I will try and gather some real world data with this. Marking as draft until I figure out the above."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "c:5061422051",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "making the checkBlock() IPC faster, intended to be called frequently by the Job Declarator Server role in Stratum v2",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": [
        "checkBlock()",
        "makeTemplate()",
        "TextBlockValidity"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "r:4880773604",
      "verdict": "",
      "reason": "Another performance improvement, a must-have follow-up of #35295/#34164/#31132, looks good.",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": [
        "src/validation.cpp"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "author",
      "what": "address l0rinc's reentrancy assert and benchmark comments, and gather real-world timing data while in draft",
      "id": "c:5958877977"
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Re-read added suggestions from l0rinc, sedited, and optout21. l0rinc and the author agreed on an assertion solution for reentrancy, but the PR is currently marked draft awaiting the push and real-world timing benchmarks."
}
